reason: Nobody in our kindergarten group has mentioned Kiddo yet, so I would download the free letters and numbers and watch my son with it, but I would not pay until other mothers say their children really learned from it. The 14-day trial without a card is nice, but two weeks is not enough for me to see if he learns or just plays with the mascot.
objection: Will my child actually learn the letters, or just tap the mascot and play? Phones already take too much of his attention, and I don't want to pay to give him more screen time.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three mothers from our kindergarten Telegram group, or the teacher, saying their child learned the Uzbek letters with it before first grade.
